Existing app tables consequently expose non-RLS privileges (including TRUNCATE, REFERENCES, TRIGGER and PostgreSQL 17+ MAINTAIN) and unnecessary direct DML. A loopback-only test overlay and read-only postconditions are prepared; neither has been executed. Production remains unchanged until local CRUD compatibility, RPC grants, and default-ACL behavior pass runtime tests.
